datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2022 in Burundi, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases based on standardized IPC methodology. The resulting spatial datasets represent post-assessment food insecurity outcomes aggregated by administrative or livelihood zones.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought and conflict.
